title: openOODA MCP Server
tagline: 23 tools across 5 tiers. 14 capability tokens. v0.5.0.
content:
## What it is

`ooda-mcp` is a pure-`.oo` self-hosted Model Context Protocol server. It speaks MCP `2024-11-05` over stdio (JSON-RPC 2.0 framed) and exposes 23 typed tools under `tools/call`. Transport-only adapter: it parses JSON-RPC envelopes, runs an OODA dispatch loop, and emits framed responses. All semantic logic lives in the engine sub-modules.

## Install

The MCP server ships as part of the ooda toolchain. Once `ooda` is on PATH, you have `ooda mcp`.

## Surface

23 tools, organized in 5 tiers:

| Tier | Count | Examples |
|------|-------|----------|
| 0 — Core | 5 | `get_capability_graph`, `get_orientation`, `read_board`, `refresh_dynamic_graph`, `get_audit_log` |
| 1 — Token economy | 5 | `get_board_index`, `summarize_board`, `compress_orient`, `get_context_budget`, `estimate_chars` |
| 2 — OODA state | 4 | `get_ooda_phase`, `get_decision_journal`, `get_redteam_realtime`, `get_session_diagnostics` |
| 3 — Format | 2 | `get_format_constraints`, `validate_codex_format` |
| 4 — Workspace + audit | 7 | `get_northstar`, `get_security_threat_model`, `get_redteam_methodology`, `get_workflow_protocol`, `get_em_swarm`, `get_milestone_status`, `audit_compact` |

16 RPC methods total: `initialize`, `tools/list`, `tools/call`, `resources/list`, `resources/read`, `prompts/list`, `prompts/get`, `ping`, `shutdown`, `exit`, `roots/list`, plus 5 notifications. Server refuses `sampling/createMessage`.

Transports: `stdio` (default), `file` (one-shot), `socket` (Unix-domain). All use Content-Length framing.

## Version contract

```
mcp=0.5.0
oooda=2.10.0
ooda_max=2.99.0
oodac=2.10.0
std=2.10.0
api_surface=7
```

See `openOODA/mcp/docs/` for the full reference: `MCP_SETUP.oot`, `TOOLS.oot`, `protocol.oot`, `client_config.oot`.
